findings.quote: UBS still forecasts Brent at $95 by year-end, which assumes the strait reopens.
findings.why: UBS's context says its base case assumes limited energy disruption, and nothing states the $95 forecast depends on the strait reopening.
findings.fix: Say the $95 year-end forecast rests on UBS assuming limited energy disruption.

findings.quote: Scotiabank flagged the Reserve Bank of Australia as widely expected to resume hiking.
findings.why: Scotiabank's note says the RBA hike to 4.6% was expected on Tuesday September 29, which has already passed, not later in the autumn.
findings.fix: Drop the RBA from the later-autumn list or state that the hike was expected on September 29.
